'''Magnaspecs''' were a type of [[spectacles]]. The [[Jedi archivist/Legends|Jedi archivist]] [[Mander Zuma]] owned a pair of magnaspecs that consisted of two [[Color/Legends|pink]]-colored lenses inset with hezagonal frames that contained [[Magnet/Legends|magnets]] to hold the frames in place once worn. The lenses emitted a low intensity red light when tapped. In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], Zuma wore his magnaspecs while investigating a [[Bomu Clan]] [[Unidentified Makem Te warehouse|warehouse]] on the planet [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]]. Zuma later donned the spectacles again while taking off from [[Makem Te spaceport]] aboard [[Suwantek Systems|Suwantek]] [[TL-1200 transport]] ''[[New Ambition]]'', accompanied by the [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] [[Reen Irana]] and [[Eddey Be'ray]].<ref name="Scourge">[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]</ref>
